text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as explicit opening subject and governing source of the whole maritime-benefit chain
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name root field associated with worshipful dependence, divine authority, and unique referent; local usage remains the proper name
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) opens before any useful thing appears. The named subject makes the sea, ship-motion, command, bounty, and gratitude dependent effects rather than autonomous natural goods. Root-family pressure can deepen the sense of worshipful dependence, but the local word remains the proper name. The later possessive endings on command and bounty keep returning the chain to this opener, while the sea-subjection parallel at 14:32 shows the familiar pattern now pushed toward bounty-seeking and gratitude. Across the boundary from warning in 45:11, the opening also sounds like a fresh benefaction scene: the repeated opening sound binds agent, linker, and sea before the purpose clauses begin.

topics.headline: named agency before utility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah names the agent before sea, ship, commerce, or response appears.
topics.reason: The proper noun stands as nominative subject and antecedent of the relative clause, so the later maritime chain depends on named agency.

topics.headline: divine identity frames dependence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears sea-service as a disclosure of worshipful dependence, while local grammar keeps the word functioning as the proper divine name.
topics.reason: Root-family and derivational pressure can enrich dependence and awe, but the local surface remains the proper name, not an unpacked etymology.

topics.headline: command and bounty return to the opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the later command and bounty are not independent forces but possessions routed back to the opening subject.
topics.reason: The possessive suffixes in the command and bounty phrases are licensed as returning to the opening divine subject.

topics.headline: formula and parallel sea-subjection frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this opening as part of a recognizable divine sea-subjection pattern, with 45:12 driving that pattern toward gratitude.
topics.reason: The row evidence gives a concrete parallel at 14:32, and the local wording shares divine naming, subjection, sea, ships, and command while adding bounty-seeking and gratitude.

topics.headline: boundary shift into addressed benefaction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah move from rejected signs to a new benefaction scene whose opening sound binds agent, linker, and sea.
topics.reason: The boundary rows are coherent with the ayah shift after 45:11, and the sound note supports the opening linkage without changing the parse.

words.gloss_range: singular relative pronoun linking the named subject to the sea-subjection description
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) makes the following action clause identify the opening subject. It keeps the act of subjecting the sea grammatically dependent on the named agent, and its frame stretches through the two purpose clauses toward the final gratitude outcome. The singular linker also prevents the reader from attaching the description to later collective nouns.

topics.headline: relative link identifies through action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sea-subjection is not a detached report but the identifying content attached to the named subject.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun attaches to the opening subject and makes the following action clause its descriptive content.

topics.headline: relative frame contains the purposes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees motion, seeking, and gratitude held inside one divine description rather than scattered into separate favors.
topics.reason: The relative clause extends through the subjection clause and its purpose/result sequence.

topics.headline: singular linker blocks misattachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can keep the grammatical attachment clear: the linker points back to the singular divine antecedent, not to later plural or collective words.
topics.reason: The masculine singular relative form agrees with the opening antecedent and functions as a bound relative expression.

words.gloss_range: causative subjection or harnessing of the sea for the addressees; not mockery or mere permission
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes derision and service/subordination branches; local Form II with sea object selects imposed serviceability
words.prose: {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) is the accomplished act on which the rest of the ayah depends. Its Form II force makes the sea serviceable for the addressees, while local grammar keeps the sea as the object and the people as beneficiaries. The root can move through mockery elsewhere, but here the maritime object selects harnessing into ordered use. Ship-running then appears as the visible result of this subjection, and the command phrase keeps that motion under divine governance. The sea-subjection parallel at 16:14 confirms the formula, and the next ayah (45:13) widens the same subjection root from this maritime panel to a broader cosmic scope.

topics.headline: completed act with object and beneficiaries
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ongoing ship-motion and human seeking rest on an already-accomplished act of subjection.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect Form II with the sea as direct object and the addressees as beneficiaries.

topics.headline: Form II service-making, not mockery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sea made serviceable by imposed divine ordering, while the derision branch is excluded by the local Form II maritime frame.
topics.reason: The root has derision and service branches, but the actual causative Form II with the sea object selects controlled serviceability.

topics.headline: sea-subjection recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a recurring sea-subjection formula, here sharpened by command and directed toward gratitude.
topics.reason: The concrete 16:14 parallel and root pairing support the formula without overriding local syntax.

topics.headline: subjection frames visible motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ship-running as the visible effect of prior harnessing and continuing command, not as a merely mechanical fact.
topics.reason: The subjection verb opens the act and the command phrase closes the motion beat.

topics.headline: maritime panel before wider subjection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this sea-service as the first panel before the next ayah expands subjection more widely, with the doubled sound reinforcing imposed service.
topics.reason: The next ayah repeats the subjection root in a wider scope, and the phonetic row adds local emphasis without changing sense.

words.gloss_range: benefactive second-person plural phrase marking the addressees as recipients of sea-subjection
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمُ}} ({{tr:lakumu}}) attaches the addressees to the act before the sea is even named. The preposition marks benefit and direction, not ownership, so the controlled sea remains a divine gift turned toward them. The same second-person group later seeks bounty and is summoned toward gratitude, making recipients into moral respondents rather than passive users. That second-person turn also contrasts with the third-person rejecters in 45:11, moving the discourse from warning about them to endowment addressed to you.

topics.headline: beneficiary phrase before object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressees are marked as beneficiaries before the vast controlled object is named.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase attaches to the subjection verb and precedes the sea object.

topics.headline: benefit and assignment without ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sea directed for the addressees without turning it into their possession.
topics.reason: The relation licenses benefit and direction; nothing in the local grammar grants ownership of the sea.

topics.headline: beneficiaries become seekers and thankers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same audience from received benefit into seeking and finally into gratitude.
topics.reason: The second-person plural suffix begins the address thread continued in the later seeking, outcome, and gratitude forms.

topics.headline: from third-person warning to direct benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the discourse turn from rejected third-person figures into direct second-person endowment.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the switch after 45:11 from third-person rejection to addressed beneficiaries.

words.gloss_range: the definite sea as a whole maritime domain made serviceable and later resumed as the place of ship-motion
words.root_gloss_range: root field evokes expanse, opening, and broad water-domain; locally selected as the sea object of subjection
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَحْرَ}} ({{tr:al-baḥra}}) names the vast definite domain that is being subjected. The word is not background scenery: it is the object acted upon, then it returns as the place in which ships run. Its singular mass shape gathers the maritime field as one domain rather than countable fragments. Its expanse and opening imagery make the point sharper, because the separating water-domain becomes a passable field for benefit. The wider maritime parallels at 22:65 keep this as a sign-pattern, not just a travel note, and after rejection in 45:11 the heavy sea-word opens into motion and response.

topics.headline: known sea as subjection object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the vast known sea is what is acted upon, not merely the scenery around human navigation.
topics.reason: The noun is definite accusative and syntactically forced as the direct object of the subjection verb.

topics.headline: expanse opened for passage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a separating, expansive water-domain becoming passable and useful.
topics.reason: The root-image rows fit the local sea object and do not require importing an unrelated branch.

topics.headline: singular definite maritime field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sea gathered as one domain of operation rather than fragmented into countable seas.
topics.reason: The singular definite mass noun functions as the domain later resumed by the locative pronoun.

topics.headline: sea before ships and resumed as container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the sea from object of subjection to container of ship-motion.
topics.reason: The sea precedes the ships and is later resumed by the pronoun in the locative phrase.

topics.headline: maritime sign economy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the local sea as part of a wider maritime sign pattern that answers prior rejection with visible benefaction.
topics.reason: Concrete parallel evidence at 22:65 and boundary rows support the sign-economy reading.

topics.headline: sound and use-to-response ring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the heavy sea-word open into motion while the verse returns the sea-domain toward gratitude.
topics.reason: The sound row and convergence row add a local rhetorical payoff while preserving the object-container structure.

words.gloss_range: first purpose particle linking sea-subjection to ship-running
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the first purpose hinge. It binds the sea's subjection to the running of ships, so motion is presented as the intended outcome and visible result of the controlled sea. The particle is small, but it turns the clause from naming the object to showing what that object is for, and its tight attachment makes purpose and running feel joined.

topics.headline: first purpose governs ship-running
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verse pivots from the controlled sea to the purpose that ships run within it.
topics.reason: The prefixed purpose particle governs the following subjunctive motion verb.

topics.headline: purpose and result both felt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ship-motion as both the intended use and the resulting manifestation of sea-subjection.
topics.reason: The particle opens the first purpose/result clause after the subjection verb.

topics.headline: particle bound to motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the small particle cling to the motion verb, making purpose and running feel joined.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local and reinforces the syntactic fusion.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive running or coursing of ships within the purpose frame
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on flowing, running, and ordered course; locally it is ship-motion governed by purpose and command
words.prose: {{ar:تَجْرِىَ}} ({{tr:tajriya}}) is motion under purpose, not motion in isolation. The verb's dependency on the preceding particle keeps the running inside the design of sea-subjection. Its flow-image remains positive: the ships course through the sea as an ordered operation, while the later command phrase prevents the motion from sounding self-sufficient. Because the verb precedes its subject, the reader meets movement before the ships are named; the flowing sound then carries into the sea-locative that follows. The accepted agreement variant makes the collective ship subject more visible without changing the local referent.

topics.headline: dependent motion under purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ships run only inside a purpose frame opened by the preceding particle.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is subjunctive after the purpose particle.

topics.headline: collective agreement made visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the collective subject already anticipated in the verb, with the accepted variant highlighting agreement pressure rather than changing the referent.
topics.reason: The feminine agreement anticipates the collective ships; the variant evidence is useful as agreement contrast, not as a replacement of the canonical surface.

topics.headline: flow becomes governed operation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels natural flowing motion recast as ordered course inside divine command.
topics.reason: The root flow image fits the local motion verb and is bounded by the purpose and command frames.

topics.headline: motion appears before subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader encounters movement before the ships are named, so the running itself becomes the first visible effect of subjection.
topics.reason: Verb-first order places motion before the delayed subject, and the motion realizes the earlier subjection.

topics.headline: liquid motion carries forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the running as part of a broader ordered-course pattern, carried into the sea-locative that follows.
topics.reason: The intertextual and sound rows converge around ordered running without displacing the local ship-motion sense.

words.gloss_range: definite collective ships or vessel-class as delayed subject of the running verb
words.root_gloss_range: root range can evoke circling/course and vessel usage; locally the noun denotes ships as a collective moving class
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفُلْكُ}} ({{tr:al-fulku}}) resolves the motion that came first. The delayed nominative subject makes the reader feel running before seeing the ships, then gathers the vehicles as a definite collective class. The collective form explains the agreement pressure and the accepted variant evidence without changing the referent. A course-image can color the scene, but the local word remains the ships that run in the subjected sea. The recurrent running-ship pairing also echoes 31:31, while this ayah ties that pairing more explicitly to divine command.

topics.headline: delayed subject resolves motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first feels motion and then learns the moving subject is the ship-collective.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative as the delayed subject after the verb.

topics.headline: collective bridges singular and plural
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why a collective ship-word can pair with feminine agreement and variant pressure without changing the scene.
topics.reason: The collective noun licenses singular-like and plural-like behavior; variant evidence clarifies agreement, not referent.

topics.headline: definite moving class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees not one named vessel but the class of ships as the vehicle of maritime benefit.
topics.reason: The definite collective shape treats ships as a moving class.

topics.headline: course or orbit image within vessels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a course-pattern around the ships, while local grammar keeps the surface meaning as vessels rather than abstract orbit.
topics.reason: The root image can color the motion relation, but the local noun denotes ships.

topics.headline: running and vessel inseparable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the recurrent running-ship pairing, here tied specifically to divine command rather than left generic.
topics.reason: The collocation rows and 31:31 parallel support the motion-vehicle formula.

topics.headline: subject placed between motion and sea return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ships inserted between the running verb and the sea-locative, binding vehicle to domain.
topics.reason: The delayed subject comes after motion and before the locative return to the sea.

words.gloss_range: prepositional locative phrase resuming the sea as the domain inside which ships run
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) brings the sea back after the ships appear. What was the object of subjection becomes the inside-domain where motion happens, so the verse does not leave the sea as a static object. The compact suffix also starts a chain of returns that will later attach command and bounty to their owner.

topics.headline: locative suffix resumes sea
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the sea returning as the inside-domain of ship-motion after serving as the object of subjection.
topics.reason: The pronoun suffix is syntactically forced to resume the sea as the motion domain.

topics.headline: inside and operating field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ships not merely near the sea but operating within the domain that has been made serviceable.
topics.reason: The preposition plus suffix compresses literal location and operational domain.

topics.headline: first suffix return in the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first pronoun return before the later divine suffixes attach command and bounty to their owner.
topics.reason: This suffix resumes the sea, beginning the sequence of compact referential returns.

words.gloss_range: preposition introducing command as the means or cause under which ship-motion occurs
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) changes the motion clause from where ships run to by what authority they run. The preposition makes the following command phrase the operative means or cause, so the sea-domain and the ships do not explain themselves. Its brevity also helps the command phrase lock tightly onto the motion and prepares the paired possessed endings of command and bounty.

topics.headline: motion under means and cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ship-motion is placed under command as its means or cause, not left as autonomous movement.
topics.reason: The preposition introduces the command phrase as instrumental or causal complement to the running verb.

topics.headline: small link fuses command to motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the clause move from location to causation: ships run in the sea, but by command.
topics.reason: The proclitic directly attaches the command noun to the motion predicate after the locative phrase.

topics.headline: sound prepares paired possessions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the short link prepare the later paired command and bounty endings.
topics.reason: The cadence row gives a local sound payoff tied to the command-bounty pair.

words.gloss_range: possessed command or governing affair as the operative means by which ships run
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers command, matter, affair, and decree; locally narrowed to divine command as operative governance of motion
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihi}}) closes the ship-motion beat on authority. The ships run in the sea, but the clause lands on possessed command, so motion is not treated as self-running nature. The word can carry command, affair, and decree pressure; locally the prepositional frame selects operative command. The creation-and-command distinction at 7:54 lets this maritime order sound like execution of divine command, not just natural regularity. Its suffix returns to the opening subject, and its pairing with the later bounty phrase joins governance of motion to ownership of surplus.

topics.headline: command governs motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the motion beat closes on command rather than on the ship or sea.
topics.reason: The genitive noun is governed by the preceding preposition as the operative phrase with the running verb.

topics.headline: command owned by the opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees command as possessed by the opening divine subject, not as an abstract natural law.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix is strongly licensed as referring to the opening subject.

topics.headline: command, affair, decree pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels directive authority and ordered affair together, while the local prepositional phrase selects command as the active force for motion.
topics.reason: The root range includes command, affair, and decree; local grammar narrows it to operative divine command without losing ordered-affair pressure.

topics.headline: creation-command distinction colors order
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears maritime order against the creation-and-command distinction at 7:54, making the ship-course an execution of divine command.
topics.reason: The concrete 7:54 reference supports command as a governing category without altering local syntax.

topics.headline: command paired with later bounty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the authority that moves ships paired with the bounty humans seek, tying economy to governance.
topics.reason: The repeated suffix and cadence link this command phrase to the later bounty phrase.

topics.headline: stacked dependency converges
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees vehicle, sea, and human benefit nested inside a layered dependency on divine command.
topics.reason: The rows converge on preposition, command noun, suffix, and running-pair dependency.

words.gloss_range: conjunction adding a second purpose clause to the first purpose of ship-running
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not merely continue the sentence; it adds a second purpose. The first purpose showed ships running, and this conjunction opens the move toward human seeking without collapsing the two. Its repeated particle rhythm makes livelihood feel like an added stage in the same benefaction chain.

topics.headline: second purpose added without collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees bounty-seeking added to ship-running as a distinct second purpose, not blended into the same clause.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the second purpose clause to the first while preserving separate governance by the next purpose particle.

topics.headline: coordination extends benefit chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah move from enabled motion into directed human livelihood.
topics.reason: The conjunction and following purpose particle extend the chain from ships running to humans seeking.

topics.headline: repeated purpose cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the added purpose as a rhythmic continuation of the first purpose frame.
topics.reason: The sound row is local to the repeated particle sequence.

words.gloss_range: second purpose particle governing the addressees seeking from divine bounty
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) places human seeking under the same kind of purpose frame that governed ship-running. Motion and livelihood therefore stand as parallel outcomes of the subjected sea. The repeated purpose rhythm also sets up the later shift: after what the sea enables, the ayah turns to what the addressees may become.

topics.headline: human seeking under purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human seeking is also placed under purpose, not presented as free-standing acquisition.
topics.reason: The second purpose particle governs the following subjunctive human verb.

topics.headline: repeated purpose frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees motion and livelihood as parallel purposes of the sea subjection.
topics.reason: The repeated purpose particle links ship-running and bounty-seeking as coordinated purpose clauses.

topics.headline: particle rhythm prepares modal shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated purpose particles prepare the later shift into hoped gratitude.
topics.reason: The rhythm row is coherent with the local sequence from two purpose clauses to the outcome particle.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural deliberate seeking from a bounded divine source; legitimate pursuit with overreach pressure constrained
words.root_gloss_range: root range spans seeking, desire, and overreach/contention; local Form VIII plus source phrase selects licensed pursuit
words.prose: {{ar:تَبْتَغُوا۟}} ({{tr:tabtaghū}}) makes the beneficiaries active. They do not only watch ships run; they seek from the bounty opened by that motion. The root can carry desire and overreach pressure, but the Form VIII shape and the following source phrase discipline the action into legitimate pursuit. The wider seek-from-bounty formula at 62:10 supports the positive reading, while the nearby contrast at 45:17 shows why the pursuit must stay bounded and sourced. The second-person thread keeps that pursuit from becoming the endpoint, because the same addressees are carried on toward gratitude.

topics.headline: addressed seeking under purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same addressees who benefited from the sea now become active seekers within a governed purpose clause.
topics.reason: The verb is second-person plural subjunctive after the second purpose particle.

topics.headline: seeking takes source phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees human pursuit as downstream from enabled motion and bounded by the source phrase that follows.
topics.reason: The following source phrase governs the semantic boundary of the seeking verb.

topics.headline: seeking with overreach pressure controlled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels desire and possible overreach disciplined into legitimate seeking from divine bounty.
topics.reason: The root family includes overreach or contention pressure, but local Form VIII and the source phrase select licensed pursuit.

topics.headline: deliberate seeking, not passive receipt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressees actively pursue bounty rather than merely receive benefit passively.
topics.reason: The actual Form VIII morphology marks directed pursuit and narrows away from raw overreach.

topics.headline: seek-bounty formula and contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a wider seek-from-bounty formula at 62:10 while 45:17 warns how the same root-field can turn into contention.
topics.reason: The concrete references support both licensed bounty-seeking and the nearby contrast with contentious motive.

topics.headline: seekers become potential thankers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the addressees from benefit into pursuit and then toward gratitude, so acquisition is not the endpoint.
topics.reason: The second-person thread and convergence row link the verb to the earlier beneficiary phrase and final gratitude verb.

words.gloss_range: source and partitive preposition bounding human seeking to a share from divine bounty
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) is the boundary on pursuit. It makes the coming bounty the source from which seeking draws and also allows the sense of a share rather than the whole field. That means economic action is not open-ended acquisition; it closes on a possessed source and immediately prepares the gratitude clause.

topics.headline: source and share limit seeking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that pursuit draws from divine bounty and takes a share, rather than claiming the whole field.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the bounty noun as source and can also carry partitive limitation.

topics.headline: single preposition closes pursuit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the seeking clause close with a boundary, so pursuit is not left open-ended.
topics.reason: The compact preposition directly links the seeking verb to the possessed bounty phrase.

topics.headline: bounded pursuit prepares gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels source-limited pursuit become the immediate basis for hoped gratitude.
topics.reason: The phrase immediately precedes the outcome clause, and the sound row reinforces the bond between limit and bounty.

words.gloss_range: possessed divine bounty or surplus favor as the source from which humans seek
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers surplus, excess, favor, preference, and advantage; locally selected as divine bounty from which a share is sought
words.prose: {{ar:فَضْلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:faḍlihi}}) names what human pursuit draws from: not a commodity list, but possessed bounty. The source preposition and suffix keep the gain as a share from divine surplus, not an entitlement owned by seekers. The root pressure of excess and favor lets economic benefit remain real while refusing to reduce it to commerce. Because this phrase stands just before the gratitude outcome, the ayah makes surplus favor a direct prompt for recognition, and the 30:46 parallel confirms the ships-command-bounty-thanks pattern. Its possessed ending echoes the earlier command phrase, so the same owner holds both the authority that moves ships and the surplus humans seek.

topics.headline: bounty sourced and owned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is sought is a possessed divine bounty, not an abstract economic category owned by seekers.
topics.reason: The genitive noun is governed by the source preposition and its suffix returns to the opening subject.

topics.headline: surplus favor beyond commerce
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels gain as surplus favor beyond due measure, not merely self-produced commerce.
topics.reason: The root rows support surplus, favor, and advantage pressure within the local bounty phrase.

topics.headline: bounty not named commodity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the object of seeking remain surplus favor rather than a specific maritime product.
topics.reason: The noun is maṣdar-like and abstract, while the comparative family supports more-than-bare-provision pressure.

topics.headline: bounty immediately demands response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees gratitude respond especially to divine surplus, not only to ship-motion or command.
topics.reason: The bounty phrase immediately precedes the hoped gratitude clause and participates in a recurrent bounty-thanks pairing.

topics.headline: ships, favor, and gratitude parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the maritime theology of 30:46, now with explicit sea-subjection at the opening of 45:12.
topics.reason: The concrete 30:46 parallel links ships, command, seeking bounty, and gratitude.

topics.headline: command and bounty share owner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same owner holds both the command moving ships and the bounty humans seek.
topics.reason: The repeated suffix links command and bounty back to the opening subject.

topics.headline: owned surplus points to recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the command-bounty cadence and sees owned surplus aimed toward recognition.
topics.reason: The cadence and convergence rows preserve a rhetorical payoff tied to the same grammatical suffix pattern.

words.gloss_range: conjunction linking the final hoped-gratitude clause to the preceding purpose chain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the gratitude clause attached to everything before it. The chain does not stop with ships running or people seeking; it turns toward response. The repeated conjunction sound matters because the earlier addition opened livelihood, while this one opens a different kind of clause: hoped gratitude.

topics.headline: gratitude clause attached to chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final gratitude clause remains connected to the prior purposes while shifting into a new modal force.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the final outcome clause to the purpose chain before the outcome particle governs it.

topics.headline: coordination resumes at higher level
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the discourse move from enabled utility to the hoped human response.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates continuity while the fused outcome particle marks the modal shift.

topics.headline: same conjunction, changed force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears two additions with different functions: one adds livelihood, the other introduces response.
topics.reason: The repeated conjunction cadence is tied to a real shift from second purpose to hoped outcome.

words.gloss_range: outcome particle with second-person plural suffix, making gratitude a hoped or elicited response
words.prose: {{ar:لَعَلَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:laʿallakum}}) changes the telos of the verse. The previous purpose particles named what the sea enables; this word makes the final response desired but still open. Its suffix brings the same addressees back into view, so those who benefited and sought are now held under the possibility of gratitude. Across the boundary from 45:11, the discourse moves from verdict on rejecters to invited second-person response.

topics.headline: gratitude hoped, not automatic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices gratitude is desired and elicited, not commanded directly or mechanically produced by benefit.
topics.reason: The outcome particle governs the final gratitude predicate and carries hope, expectation, or purpose-like elicitation.

topics.headline: same addressees in final frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the beneficiaries back into the final response frame as the same addressed group.
topics.reason: The second-person plural suffix is resumed by the final verb and echoes the earlier beneficiary phrase.

topics.headline: conjunction, modality, address stacked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one compact word shift from the benefit chain to the ayah-ending possibility of gratitude.
topics.reason: The surface stacks conjunction, modal particle, and plural pronoun before the final predicate.

topics.headline: from purposes to moral possibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the grammar shift from what the sea enables to the uncertain human response that should follow.
topics.reason: The sequence moves from repeated purpose particles to the outcome particle, making gratitude invited rather than automatic.

topics.headline: from verdict to invited response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the prior third-person warning give way to a second-person opening for response.
topics.reason: The boundary rows are coherent with the shift from 45:11 punishment language to 45:12 hoped gratitude.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperfect gratitude as an open, continuing response to the benefit chain
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers gratitude, acknowledgement, and thankful response in speech, recognition, and use; locally it is the hoped final response
words.prose: {{ar:تَشْكُرُونَ}} ({{tr:tashkurūna}}) is the last word and the response the chain has been building toward. Under the outcome particle it is not a direct command and not a guaranteed effect; it remains an open, continuing act of gratitude. The same addressees who benefited and sought now become potential thankers, so human pursuit is paired with manifest acknowledgement rather than left as acquisition. The sea-subjection parallel at 16:14 confirms the recurring benefit-to-gratitude formula, while 45:12 expands it through command and bounty before closing on response.

topics.headline: gratitude as open outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final verb is not an imperative or automatic result but an open, continuing response under the outcome particle.
topics.reason: The indicative imperfect functions as predicate after the outcome particle, leaving gratitude open as response.

topics.headline: beneficiaries assigned gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same plural audience from benefit and seeking to the final responsibility of gratitude.
topics.reason: The second-person plural form agrees with the outcome-particle suffix and echoes the earlier beneficiary and seeking forms.

topics.headline: gratitude answers whole benefit chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees gratitude as manifest acknowledgement that answers subjection, motion, pursuit, and bounty together.
topics.reason: The root field of gratitude fits the final response to the entire chain of benefits.

topics.headline: pursuit paired with gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears human seeking and human thanking as paired actions, with the final imperfect giving the response continuing force.
topics.reason: The second-person endings connect the seeking verb and the final gratitude verb.

topics.headline: recurring sea-benefit gratitude formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the recurring benefit-to-gratitude formula, especially the sea-subjection closure at 16:14, now expanded by command and bounty.
topics.reason: The concrete 16:14 parallel and formula rows support the broader gratitude pattern.

topics.headline: ayah closes on response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah framed from divine agency at the opening to human gratitude at the close.
topics.reason: The final word closes the chain on response, and the convergence row explicitly frames the opening agent and closing gratitude.

baseline_models.mechanism: God makes a broad and otherwise difficult medium serviceable; vessels move within that enabled field under binding direction, human seeking draws a non-obligatory gift from it, and recognition of the giver closes the causal chain.

activation_trace.role: Directed subjection makes the sea serviceable and supplies the first enabling link.
Broad abundant water supplies the material field that must be traversed.
Flowing motion turns the enabled field into an operative transport path.
The vessel is the concrete carrier through which the enabled motion becomes useful.
Binding direction supplies governance rather than leaving the vessel's motion accidental.
Purposeful seeking converts enabled movement into intentional human acquisition.
A freely given benefit identifies the sought result as benefaction, not mere possession.
Recognition and praise return the gained benefit relationally to its giver.

changed_reading.before: God makes the sea usable so ships can carry people toward provision, inviting thanks.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is a purposive system: governed material motion enables responsible seeking, gift reception, and a relational return through gratitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of running, seeking surplus, and gratitude links the maritime route to continuing increase rather than a single voyage.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sea's expanse supports recurrent circulation. What moves through it can arrive as remainder beyond need, while the less expected material branches of gratitude depict a small input becoming visibly sufficient and then abundant; gratitude is therefore productive reception, not only speech after receipt.

activation_trace.role: Expansiveness makes the sea a network-scale field rather than a single local object.
An allowance that keeps running supplies the model's continuity of provision.
Remainder beyond immediate need supplies the surplus that circulation redistributes.
Visible sufficiency from little recasts gratitude as making received benefit bear effect.
Fullness and abundance extend that effect from sufficiency to generative increase.

changed_reading.before: People use shipping to find wealth and then verbally thank God.
changed_reading.after: Maritime motion circulates surplus, and gratitude names a fruitful mode of receiving in which even little benefit becomes visibly sufficient and abundant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vessel runs in an exposed expanse by command while people actively seek, leaving room for agency inside divine ordering.
baseline_models.mechanism: Open water requires orientation. The vessel's running can be imagined as delegated agency moving on a rounded course, while command contributes both route-marking and deliberative direction; divine governance bounds human and vessel agency rather than replacing it.

activation_trace.role: Exposure in open space creates the navigational problem this model addresses.
The agent or envoy image lets the running vessel function as delegated action.
Rotation and coursing give the delegated movement a bounded itinerary.
A marker or appointed point supplies orientation across the exposed field.
Deliberation and settled resolve preserve purposeful agency within that orientation.
Active pursuit keeps the human traveler from becoming a merely passive beneficiary.

changed_reading.before: Ships move passively because a divine command directly propels them.
changed_reading.after: The scene permits delegated navigation: vessels and seekers exercise real purpose inside a divinely marked and bounded course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening presents divine communication as delivered, binding, and precisely formed, then identifies created realities as visible signs. That sequence lets the focus's command-governed ship motion read as a material register of the same communicative order.

activation_trace.role: Binding direction is the focus anchor through which textual and material order can meet.
Observable running supplies the material enactment of that direction.
Delivery from a source introduces order as something made to reach recipients.
Inscription that establishes an obligation gives delivered order binding force.
Precision and sound construction supply the quality of the order being enacted.
A visible marker permits created operation to be read rather than merely consumed.

structural_cues: 45:2 opens with delivered scripture, and 45:3 immediately shifts to signs in the heavens and earth before the focus's material chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, binding inscription, precision, and visible markers; I infer that their common divine source lets them illuminate 'by His command' as enacted material order. A live alternative is that the opening identifies revelation only and the maritime command remains purely causal.

changed_reading.before: The command is an unseen force that causes ships to move.
changed_reading.after: The sea-and-vessel system can be read as intelligible enacted order, materially corresponding to an order that is also delivered and inscribed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rain is delivered as provision, revives land, and joins the turning of winds as a visible sign for restrained intelligence. The focus's sea route is therefore not an isolated transport utility but one phase in a water-air-life-provision circuit whose intelligibility should produce gratitude.

activation_trace.role: Abundant water anchors the context's ecological circulation back in the focus.
Flow gives the circuit its transport mechanism.
Benefaction identifies provision as received gift within the circuit.
Recognition of benefaction is the human response that completes the circuit.
Delivered rainfall supplies the vertical input to the material cycle.
Rain understood as provision directly joins water movement to sustenance.
Land revived through rain supplies the circuit's life-producing outcome.
Turning from state to state supplies cyclic variation rather than static control.
Moving air links atmospheric circulation to the focus's moving vessels.
The visible-marker image makes the entire sequence legible as evidence.
Intellect as restraint from folly supplies the disciplined recognition the sign requires.

structural_cues: 45:5 orders rain, provision, revived land, turning winds, signs, and understanding in one causal sequence before 45:12 orders sea, vessel, bounty, and gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both sequences and their water, motion, provision, and response terms; I infer that the earlier ecological cycle is the larger mechanism containing the maritime one. The live alternative is that the two are parallel examples rather than phases of one circuit.

changed_reading.before: The sea is a useful route for obtaining goods.
changed_reading.after: The sea route is a readable phase in a regenerative ecological circuit, so seeking bounty and giving thanks are participation in and recognition of a larger ordered life-system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding hearer receives signs but hardens into persistence, self-magnification, and ridicule. Against that response, the subjected sea and running vessel become an ethical mirror: nonhuman creation is responsive to ordering, while a human can hear without aligning; gratitude is therefore a free alignment, not an automatic effect of benefit.

activation_trace.role: Responsive subjection gives the nonhuman side of the contrast its directed compliance.
The vessel's effective running displays order translated into action.
Acknowledgment names the responsive human alternative to refusal.
The repeated hearing and pseudo-nonhearing frame a failure of understanding and compliance despite reception.
Fixed resolve supplies the mechanism that blocks received signs from changing conduct.
Self-magnification explains why the hearer resists an order that creation enacts.
Ridicule supplies the negative social response that the focus's invitation to gratitude reverses.

structural_cues: 45:8-11 forms the warning block immediately before 45:12, moving from failed hearing and ridicule to guidance, then to the responsive maritime scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compliant maritime motion and a hearer who persists after receiving signs; I supply the contrast between nonhuman responsiveness and human refusal. The live alternative is that the warning and provisioning scenes are adjacent but do not mirror one another.

changed_reading.before: Subjection explains why the sea is useful, and gratitude is a likely emotional result.
changed_reading.after: The obedient sea exposes the anomaly of the resistant hearer; gratitude becomes voluntary alignment with an order already enacted by creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats directed subjection and expands its object from the sea to everything in the heavens and earth, gathered as one field of signs for reflection. The maritime mechanism becomes a close-up specimen of comprehensive coordination rather than a privileged exception.

activation_trace.role: Directed service anchors the local maritime instance.
The sea supplies the concrete local field that is subsequently generalized.
Repeated directed service explicitly carries the focus mechanism into the universal claim.
The overarching realm supplies the upper extent of the expanded field.
The lower terrestrial realm completes the expanded field around the maritime example.
Completeness without dispersal makes the many enabled things one coordinated totality.
Visible marking turns comprehensive service into evidence rather than inventory.
Sustained inward consideration supplies the response required to recognize the pattern.

structural_cues: 45:13 immediately repeats the focus's subjection-for-you construction, widens its scope, and changes the response term from gratitude to reflection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct repetition followed by universal scope; I infer that the local mechanism is intended as a specimen through which the whole can be understood. The alternative is simple accumulation: one benefit is listed before a separate general benefit.

changed_reading.before: The sea is one specially granted human resource.
changed_reading.after: The sea-and-ship system is a inspectable local model of a comprehensive coordination spanning heavens and earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bestowed advantage is followed by conflict caused by transgressive seeking, then by a prescribed course from the command that must be followed instead of desire. The water-source branch of that prescribed course folds the legal-ethical sequence back into the maritime image: seeking bounty is legitimate movement only while it stays on a directed course.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful seeking anchors the legitimate motion that context will qualify.
The same focus root contains overreach, keeping a live boundary inside the act of seeking.
Binding direction provides the course that keeps seeking from becoming overreach.
Gift rather than entitlement identifies what course-bound seeking may receive.
Bestowed degree or advantage supplies the benefit whose social handling is tested next.
The shared affair supplies the ordered domain within which division later occurs.
Overreaching rivalry realizes the danger latent in the focus's seeking root.
A visible water-access point supplies a striking route image for the prescribed ethical course.
Binding direction explicitly connects that course back to the focus's governing command.
Repeated following presents two possible tracks and requires pursuit of the commanded one.
Inclination of desire supplies the rival steering force that can pull seeking off course.

structural_cues: 45:16 gives provision and advantage, 45:17 locates division after knowledge in overreach, and 45:18 answers with a course from the command and a follow/do-not-follow contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the gift-conflict-course sequence and a water-access branch for the prescribed course; I infer a navigational analogy back to sea travel and an ethical limit on seeking. A live alternative is that the water image is only historical morphology and that the legal sequence does not qualify maritime acquisition.

changed_reading.before: The enabled sea grants broad permission to pursue divine bounty.
changed_reading.after: The route is also an ethical course: seek gift under command, because seeking can cross into rivalry, overreach, or desire-driven deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's remainder and freely given benefit contrast with later acquired deeds, rejected moral equivalence, truthful recompense, and earned result. Maritime enterprise remains real, but its bounty is not framed as a wage owed to the seeker; gratitude answers grace, while action enters a separate exact accounting.

activation_trace.role: Surplus beyond need supplies the non-equivalent excess that cannot be reduced to wages.
Free benefaction makes the sought outcome received grace rather than debt repayment.
Grateful acknowledgment is the fitting response to gift rather than a claim of entitlement.
Contextual benefaction confirms that advantage can be bestowed rather than earned.
Acquired action supplies what persons actually produce and own morally.
Explicit equivalence is rejected between unlike moral courses, preventing indiscriminate leveling.
Reality-conforming truth grounds the accuracy of the accounting order.
Matched repayment supplies the distinct mechanism governing moral consequence.
Earned gain identifies the input to recompense and sharpens its contrast with bestowed bounty.

structural_cues: The focus says to seek from bounty, while 45:21-22 shifts to what people acquire and to each self being repaid without wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift/surplus branches and a later acquisition-recompense sequence; I infer two related but non-identical economies, grace and exact account. A live alternative is that bounty here simply names commercial earnings, while the later accounting is exclusively eschatological and offers no contrast.

changed_reading.before: The bounty found through maritime enterprise is the seeker's deserved return.
changed_reading.after: The ayah distinguishes grace from wages: people actively seek a bestowed surplus and answer with gratitude, while deeds enter a separate regime of truthful, equivalent recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rounded vessel-course acquires a temporal destination from the later sequence of return, gathering, rising, summons to a registered book, recompense, and copied work. Human movement and acquisition no longer look indefinitely outbound; they form a course that closes in return and disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Rotation gives the vessel an image of a course capable of closing rather than extending without end.
A continuing customary course supplies the temporal pattern later brought to account.
Purposeful pursuit identifies what travelers do during the course.
Return to an earlier source supplies the first explicit closure of human action.
Gathering dispersed persons turns many separate courses toward one destination.
Rising and resurrection identify the destination as more than ordinary homecoming.
A summons redirects each gathered community toward its disclosed destination.
Entry in a register gives the destination an inspectable record structure.
Matched consequence explains what happens when the course reaches its record.
Copying into a book supplies continuity between lived movement and final disclosure.
Intended deeds identify what the record preserves from the traveled course.

structural_cues: The context moves from return in 45:15 to gathering in 45:26 and then to communities called to their books and recorded work in 45:28-29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circularity in the vessel root and a later return-gathering-record sequence; I infer that the maritime course can model accountable human temporality. The live alternative is that circularity only describes vessel form or motion and carries no eschatological force.

changed_reading.before: The voyage is outbound movement toward open-ended acquisition.
changed_reading.after: The voyage can image an accountable circuit: seeking occurs along the way, but the course closes in return, gathering, and a record of what was done.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus grants movement across exposed space, but the closing judgment sequence surrounds wrongdoers with their acts, denies refuge and aid, exposes deceptive worldly attraction, and removes exit. Maritime mobility is thus a provisional mercy and opportunity, not proof of autonomy or an ultimate escape route.

activation_trace.role: Open exposure supplies the spatial field across which mobility initially appears unrestricted.
Effective movement supplies the freedom whose limits the closing context reveals.
The vessel embodies a means of passage through the open field.
Descending enclosure reverses the open mobility of the focus.
Joining a shelter supplies the terminal refuge from which movement no longer frees the traveler.
Denied aid removes the social means by which confinement might be broken.
Unstable glitter explains how worldly access and gain can be mistaken for lasting security.
The denied passage outward gives the open sea route its sharp terminal contrast.

structural_cues: 45:33-35 moves from deeds becoming manifest, to enclosure and refuge without helpers, to worldly deception and no outward passage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maritime mobility and a later cluster of enclosure, refuge, failed aid, deception, and no exit; I infer a reversal that makes present mobility provisional. The live alternative is that the closing spatial language concerns judgment only and does not retrospectively qualify sea travel.

changed_reading.before: Commanded sea travel demonstrates broad human mobility and access to gain.
changed_reading.after: That mobility is a temporary gift and testing space, not autonomous escape; pursuit dazzled by worldly access can terminate in enclosure without passage out.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because its crossing and vortex images come from non-dominant targets in split root mappings, not from the ordinary contextual senses of promise and knowing. The packet explicitly authorizes those targets, and the reading remains anchored in the focus's sea, running, and vessel. Downstream prose should present it only as an activated image and must not claim lexical equivalence between the contextual words and a raft or whirlpool.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sea, running vessel, and bounded maritime course can receive a later image of promised crossing amid professed uncertainty.

activation_trace.role: Abundant water provides the literal focus field that contains the exploratory crossing.
Flowing motion gives the crossing direction and continuity.
The actual vessel keeps the form-distant context images anchored in the focus scene.
The ordinary target grounds the cue as a promise that opens expectation toward what is coming.
The non-dominant target contributes a water-crossing float, turning expectation into a contained passage image.
The ordinary target grounds the cue in claimed knowledge or its absence.
The non-dominant target contributes a water vortex as an image of disoriented uncertainty around the crossing.

changed_reading.before: The sea passage is a present-world means of obtaining provision.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also image an eschatological crossing: promise gives raft-like orientation while professed not-knowing churns as a vortex around the vessel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because the focus's ordinary constructions favor service, legitimate seeking, bounty, and gratitude, while the audit activates their coercion, overreach, and status-claim branches. It remains valid as a focus-rooted stress test sharpened by later overreach, misplaced action, and acquired deeds. Downstream prose should qualify it as an ethical risk latent in use of the gift, not as an assertion that the ayah condemns navigation, labor, or trade.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The chain of making serviceable, seeking, claiming surplus or rank, and thanking can be tested for the point at which enabled use becomes extraction.

activation_trace.role: Compelled unpaid labor exposes a coercive edge inside the language of making serviceable.
Overstepping turns purposeful seeking into exploitative excess.
Claimed superiority makes acquired advantage socially self-exalting rather than gratefully received.
Recognition of the giver supplies the internal check against entitlement and self-exaltation.
Contextual rivalry after received knowledge demonstrates that bestowed advantage can become overreach.
Putting something in the wrong place or time supplies the audit criterion for misused access.
Acquired action makes users answerable for what they produce through the enabled system.

changed_reading.before: Subjection of the sea is an uncomplicated license to maximize accessible bounty.
changed_reading.after: As an ethical stress test, enabled access can become coercive extraction, overreach, or status claim unless gratitude preserves the gift-character of what is used and gained.

strongest_changes: The maritime utility became a readable phase within the earlier rain-wind-life-provision circuit.
The recurrence of command, seeking, and bounty around 45:16-18 turned acquisition into course-bound seeking that can deviate into overreach.
Later acquisition and recompense distinguished bestowed surplus from earned moral consequence.
Circular vessel motion acquired return, gathering, record, and the warning that present mobility is not ultimate escape.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact physical chain carried several live domains without collapsing them: ecological circulation, a mirror of responsive and resistant agency, legal-ethical navigation, grace versus accounting, and accountable return. The immediate universalization in 45:13 and the non-dominant water branches in 45:32 produced the sharpest latent expansions.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether command should remain physical causation or also carry communicated, legal, and wayfinding force.
Whether bounty is best weighted toward gift, distributable surplus, comparative advantage, or ordinary commercial gain.
How far the vessel's rotational branch can sustain an eschatological return model rather than only describing form or motion.
The split-root crossing and vortex remain deliberately form-distant images and should not be lexicalized.
The final praise may complete the focus's gratitude, but that relation did not need a separate model to support the stronger changes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Freedom of movement inside commanded service.** `س خ ر/B001` brings a thing under command for a purpose, `ج ر ي/B001` is flowing movement, and `ب ح ر/B001` is wide abundant water. The packet supplies a broad, potentially unbounded medium whose motion becomes usable under command. I infer that subjection here does not abolish movement but channels it. The sea reads as an enabling constraint: ordered service creates navigable freedom.
2. **A circular vessel within a larger circuit.** `ف ل ك/B001` is roundness and turning, and `ف ض ل/B001` is excess or remainder. This ayah's vessel moves to seek surplus; 45:13 expands subjection to all heaven and earth, and 45:26 gathers all people. I infer a circulation of command, movement, acquisition, and grateful return. The ship is thus a local model of creatures moving within a larger ordered circuit.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The universal subjection of 45:13 enlarges the navigational mechanism beyond the sea, while the final gathering in 45:26 supplies the circuit's human return-point.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The sea is delegated regularity for purposeful movement.** Lexical anchors: bringing under command for a purpose in `س خ ر B001`, habitual course in `ج ر ي B002`, ship-motion in `ف ل ك B003`, directive in `ء م ر B002`, and seeking in `ب غ ي B001`. The packet extends subjection to sky and earth in 45:13 and turns to earning and return in 45:14-15. I infer command -> stable course -> enabled seeking. The scene reads as an infrastructure of accountable agency, not passive scenery or undirected largesse.
2. **Bounty is surplus meant to become visible in its recipient.** Lexical anchors: excess/remainder in `ف ض ل B001` and being sustained by little while showing its effect in `ش ك ر B002`, alongside explicit recognition in `ش ك ر B001`. The packet supplies acquisition/recompense in 45:14-15 and another divine `فَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ` in 45:16. I infer received surplus -> productive visible response. Gratitude is assigned the role of making bounty legible through use; it is not confined to verbal thanks.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:14-15 placed seeking inside earning and return, correcting any reading of the sea as consequence-free convenience. 45:16's repeated `فَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ` made bounty as surplus responsibility, and gratitude as its visible effect, newly explicit.

baseline.text: Allah, gemiler O'nun buyruğuyla denizde yol alsın, siz de lütfundan pay arayıp şükredesiniz diye denizi hizmetinize verendir.

findings.text: Denizin hizmete verilmesi, hareketi kaldıran bir boyun eğdirme değil, buyruk altında düzenli bir rota oluşturarak amaçlı arayışı mümkün kılan bir altyapıdır.
Lütuf, alıcısında üretken bir etki olarak görünür olması gereken fazlalıktır; şükür bu fazlalığı kullanım yoluyla görünür kılar.
Dairesel hareket eden gemi, buyruk, hareket, kazanç ve şükrederek dönüşten oluşan daha büyük bir dolaşımın yerel örneğidir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Harnessed Current Carries the Vessel
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Wind and water are directed into a navigable current that bears a vessel toward sought bounty.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The sea is a field, the wind and current are instruments, the ship is the carried object, and bounty is the destination. Subjection therefore materializes as controlled transmission of force rather than inert possession.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyi bir buyruk ya da istenen sonuç doğrultusunda boyun eğdirme, yöneltme ve elverişli kılma çekirdeğinde birleşir. Bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ile geminin söz dinleyip rahat yol alması, bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir; bunlar alay etme ya da ücretsiz çalıştırma anlamını bu dala katmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, amaçlı boyun eğdirme ve elverişli kılmayla sınırlıdır; karşılıksız emek ve alay ayrı dallarda kalır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bir buyruğa veya istenen işe boyun eğdirerek o işe yöneltmek ve elverişli kılmaktır. Bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ile geminin söz dinleyip rahat yol alması bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Bir şey, kimi zaman zor kullanılarak, belirli bir işe boyun eğdirilir ve istenen sonuca doğru yöneltilir.
Boyun eğdirme çekirdeği, bir şeyi bir kimsenin yararlanmasına elverişli ve kolay duruma getirmeyi de kapsar.
Gemiye bağlı kullanımda geminin söz dinlemesi, gidişinin rahatlaması ve rüzgarın ona uygun olması anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir insanı zorlayarak karşılıksız çalıştırmayı ve bir hizmetçiyi ya da hayvanı karşılık vermeden kullanmayı açıkça dalın çekirdeği yapar. Köleler, kadın köleler ve ücretli çalışanlar üzerine yapılan açıklamalar katılımcı örnekleridir; genel kolaylaştırma veya alay anlamı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın ayırıcı koşulları zorla emek ya da hizmet alma ile ücret, bedel veya başka bir karşılık vermemedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, eylem ve kişi adlarını zorla ve karşılıksız hizmet çekirdeğinde tutar; kişi ya da hayvanla kurulan kalıpları genel boyun eğdirme anlamına yaymaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı ya da hizmette kullanılan hayvanı, ücret veya başka bir karşılık vermeden zorla çalıştırmak veya kullanmaktır. Köle, hizmetçi ve ücretli çalışanlara ilişkin adlandırmalar bu çekirdekteki katılımcı türlerini gösterir.

facets.statement: Bir kimse baskıyla çalıştırılır ve yaptığı iş için ücret ya da başka bir karşılık almaz.
Bir hizmetçi veya binek hayvanı, ücret ya da bedel ödenmeden kullanılır.
Bazı açıklamalar zorla hizmete koşulan kişileri köleler, kadın köleler ve ücretli çalışanlar üzerinden örneklendirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, birini çalışmaya zorlayıp ücret vermeme konusunda birleşir. Toplu anlatım, karşılıksız kullanılan hizmetçi veya hayvanı ve baskıyla hizmete koşulan farklı kişi türlerini aynı çekirdeğe bağlı olarak kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan emeğini ve hizmette kullanılan hayvanı kapsayan dal çekirdeğinin en kısa doğal karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorlama, çalışma veya hizmet alma ve karşılık vermeme koşullarının tümünü korur.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan katılımcı, zorlama, çalışma ve ücret ödememe koşullarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimseye istemediği ve karşılıksız bir iş yaptırma bağlamında doğal, ancak daha geniş çağrışımlı bir anlatımdır.

error_profile.preserves: İstem dışı ağır işe koşma yönünü ve baskı görünümünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Güncel kullanımda yalnızca külfetli veya istenmeyen, fakat mutlaka ücretsiz olmayan işleri de çağrıştırabilir.

error_profile.loses: Belirli bir çalıştırma eylemini ve karşılık vermeme koşulunu doğrudan anlatmaz.

error_profile.collision: Eylemi, kalıcı kişi konumu ve sahiplik düzeniyle karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda hizmet zorla alınır ve ücret ya da başka bir karşılık verilmez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السخرة والعمل المسخر بلا أجرة، وتسخر الخادم أو الدابة، وما حملته بعض المصادر على العبيد والإماء والأجراء

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü dalı açıkça birini alaya alma üzerinde kurar ve aynı söz ailesiyle alay eylemini, alay eden kişiyi ve alaya alınan kişiyi adlandırır. Gülme yalnızca tekil bir ad kullanımında görülür; bu yüzden dal başlığındaki gülme, çekirdeğin zorunlu parçası değil alaylı bir gerçekleşme olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, birini alaya almaktır; gerçek bir gülme olayı zorunlu değildir ve yalnızca bağlı bir kullanımda yer alır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ilgeçli eylem kuruluşlarını ve eylem ya da kişi bildiren türemiş biçimleri ayırır; bunları yalın kökün sınırsız anlamı gibi sunmaz.

concept_map.definition: Birini küçümseyici biçimde alaya almak ve onun üzerinden eğlenmektir. Bağlı adlandırmalar alay eylemini, alay eden veya alaya alınan kişiyi ve tekil bir kullanımda alaylı gülüşü belirtir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi küçümseyici söz veya davranışla alaya alınır.
Eylemin kaynak dilde iki ayrı ilgeçli kuruluşu kaydedilir ve bunlardan birinin kabulü konusunda görüş ayrılığı vardır.
Aynı söz ailesi alay eylemini, alay eden kişiyi veya başkalarının alay ettiği kişiyi adlandırabilir.
Tekil bir kullanım, alaylı gülüşü ya da alay amacıyla gülme eylemini adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar birini alaya alma çekirdeğinde birleşir ve eylem adı ile alay eden ya da alaya alınan kişiye ilişkin adları kaydeder. Toplu anlatım, eylemin iki ilgeçli kuruluşundan biri üzerindeki görüş ayrılığını ve tekil alaylı gülüş kullanımını da korur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kişi, kuruluş ve türemiş adlardan önce gelen ortak eylem çekirdeğini doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiyi küçümseyici tutumla alay konusu yapma çekirdeğini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bilgi, mal, otlak, söz ve at kosusu gibi alanlarda genisleme, derinlesme ve bollasmayi ortak bir nitelik olarak verir. Gecici cerceve, su kütlesinden aktarilan genislik ve yayilma fikrini dogru tutar; ancak dal hem yalın kullanimlari hem de atla ilgili tamlamayi icerdigi icin tanim bunlari ayirmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genisleme ve derinlesme mecazidir; su kütlesinin kendisi veya kulak yarma anlamini icermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mixed non-bare dal oldugu icin yalın genisleme ile at kosusuna bagli tamlama ayni cekirdekte fakat ayrik kapsamlarla verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kisi, soz, mal, otlak ya da benzeri alanda genisleyip bollasmak veya derinlesmek; at icin de kosusunun genis ve güçlü olmasi.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir alanda genisleme, bollasma veya derinlesme kazanmasidir.

error_profile.preserves: Yol boyunca gerçekleşen akış, koşu ve ilerleme ortaklığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Su ve benzeri akışkanların bir yatak ya da yön boyunca ilerlediği bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yatak boyunca kesintisiz ilerleme özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Atın koşmasını, geminin yol almasını ve öteki akışkan olmayan hareketleri dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: At gibi canlıların hızlı ayak hareketiyle ilerlediği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hızlı fiziksel ilerleme bileşenini korur.
error_profile.loses: Suyun akışını, rüzgarın geçişini, güneşin ve geminin yol alışını karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gemi ve güneş gibi bir güzergah boyunca ilerleyen varlıklar için uygun bir bağlamsal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir yol boyunca ilerleme özelliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Suyun akma biçimini ve atın koşu biçimini açıkça belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yeryüzünde görünen akan suyu ve ona bağlı su türleriyle adlandırmaları öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Suyun yüzeyde ya da yatağında akması iki dalın açık kesişim alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel bir ilerleme çekirdeğine sahiptir ve suyla sınırlı değildir; komşu dalın sınırı ise özellikle yeryüzündeki akan su ve onun türleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek bir varlığın akmasını, koşmasını ya da kendi yolunda ilerlemesini yeterli görür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başka biriyle birlikte gitme ve söyleşide ona ayak uydurma koşulunu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da hareket etme ve bir güzergah boyunca ilerleme bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bağımsız hareketi anlatır; komşu dal ise ikinci bir katılımcıyla eş zamanlı ilerlemeyi ve bundan gelişen söyleşi kullanımını gerektirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, anlamı kişinin sürekli izlediği alışılmış yol, davranış biçimi ve tutum olarak ortaklaştırır. Bu nedenle dal, fiziksel ilerleyişi değil, tekrarla yerleşmiş bir yapma ve yaşama düzenini gösterir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki yol mecazlı ve alışkanlığa bağlıdır; fiziksel hareket, aracılık ve birlikte koşma bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kanıtta yalın biçimle verilen alışkanlık ve izlenen yol anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka söz öbeklerinden anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin tekrar ederek benimsediği alışılmış davranış düzeni ya da sürekli izlediği yoldur. Tek bir eylemden değil, süreklilik kazanmış bir yapma biçiminden söz eder.

facets.statement: Kişi belli bir davranışı tekrarlayarak onu yerleşik bir alışkanlık haline getirir.
Yerleşik alışkanlık, kişinin işlerinde tuttuğu yol ya da benimsediği davranış biçimi olarak görülür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin üzerinde yürüdüğü alışılmış yol ile tekrar sonucu yerleşen davranış düzenini aynı anlam alanında birleştirir. Vurgu, süreklilik kazanmış alışkanlıktadır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin sürekli izlediği yolu ve tekrar yoluyla yerleşmiş alışkanlığı birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem yerleşik alışkanlığı hem de kişinin tuttuğu yol boyutunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tekrarlanarak yerleşmiş davranışın öne çıktığı gündelik bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Tekrar sonucu yerleşen davranış düzenini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin tuttuğu yol ve benimsediği yöntem görünümünü açıkça taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin işlerini yaparken sürekli benimsediği yöntemin öne çıktığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli izlenen davranış yolunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Tekrarla yerleşmiş kişisel alışkanlık boyutunu tek başına kesinleştirmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kişinin alışkanlık edindiği ve sürekli izlediği yol
